title: VTC: add call-level media policies
description: Zoom and Jitsi have per-call moderator-controlled policies: mute on entry, participants can unmute self, participants can share screen, participants can start video. The draft has zero call-level policy fields. Add a VTCCallPolicy embedded object on VTCCall with fields like muteOnEntry (Boolean), participantsCanUnmute (Boolean), participantsCanShareScreen (Boolean), participantsCanStartVideo (Boolean). Moderator-only mutable. Chat-level policies (disable chat, disable reactions) are JMAP Chat's concern when chat binding is present.
close_reason: Added VTCCallPolicy embedded type with muteOnEntry, videoOffOnEntry, participantsCanUnmute, participantsCanShareScreen, participantsCanStartVideo. Moderator-only mutable.
